lore_anchors.definition: A legendary cultivation technique that allows a cultivator to split a portion of their soul and energy into a separate, independent body, acting as a second self. In xianxia lore, it represents the pinnacle of bodily manipulation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the author apologize for a chapter title?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Chinese web novel culture, authors often post quick apology notes for minor errors, maintaining transparency and a direct bond with readers—the chapter counts as content.
It’s a high-level cultivation technique where a cultivator creates a separate, autonomous body from a splintered soul, effectively gaining a second life and independent combat asset.
